Ementa  
Estudo de arquiteturas de sistemas paralelos. Metodologia de desenvolvimento de programas paralelos. Análise de algoritmos paralelos. 
Medição e avaliação de programas paralelos. Implementação de algoritmos paralelos em arquiteturas multicore, manycore, aceleradores e 
heterogêneas.

EDUCATION FOR JUSTICE: CYBERCRIME AND TRAFFICKING IN PERSONS AND 
SMUGGLING OF MIGRANTS

Ementa  
Introduction to Cybercrime.  General Types of Cybercrime.  Legal Frameworks and Human Rights.  
Introduction to Digital Forensics. Cybercrime Investigation. Practical Aspects of Cybercrime Investigations and Digital Forensics. 
International Cooperation against Cybercrime.  Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Prevention 
Strategies, Policies and Programmes. 
Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Prevention  Practical Applications and Measures. Privacy and Data Protection. Cyber-Enabled Intellectual 
Property Crime. Interpersonal Cybercrime. Cyber Organized Crime. Hacktivism, Terrorism, Espionage, Disinformation Campaigns and 
Warfare in Cyberspace. Migrant Smuggling as a Specific Crime Type. Protection of the Rights of Smuggled Migrants. The Criminal Justice 
Response to Migrant Smuggling.  Prevention and Non-Criminal Justice Responses to Migrant Smuggling. Smuggling of Migrants in the 
Broader Context of Migration and its Drivers. Defining the Concept of Trafficking in Persons. Prevention of Trafficking in Persons. A 
Human Rights-Based Approach to Trafficking in Persons. The Role of Civil Society in Countering Trafficking in Persons. Smuggling of 
Migrants and Trafficking in Persons: Differences and Commonalities. Children as Smuggled Migrants and Victims of Trafficking. Gender 
Dimension in Smuggling of Migrants and Trafficking in Persons. The Links between Cybercrime, Trafficking in Persons and Smuggling of 
Migrants.
